Build Your Own Clone browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Build Your Own Clone 250+ Published on June 4, 2007 Build Your Own Clone distortion pedal Information Build Your Own Clone If you're a fan of either the DOD 250 overdrive or the MXR Distortion+, then you probably already know that the two circuits are nearly 100% identical with the exception of a few component values. The BYOC 250+ kit comes with all the parts to build to either 250 or Dist+ specs and extra diodes to experiment with the clipping section. This is also the easiest kit to build that BYOC offers, so if you are looking for an easy "first timer" project, this kit would be ideal.
